scenes.title: The inbox problem
scenes.text: Newsletters, receipts, sign-in codes. Your inbox fills up fast, and the messages that matter get buried.

scenes.title: The Inboxed approach
scenes.text: Inboxed sorts the noise into clear suggestions. You decide what stays, and what goes.

scenes.title: Scan and workspace
scenes.text: Start with a scan. Inboxed groups your mail into categories. Open any message to read it. Your mailbox stays unchanged.

scenes.title: Review and apply
scenes.text: Review the suggestions. Change a class, approve messages, and preview every action. Apply when you're ready. Missing folders are created automatically.

scenes.title: Unsubscribe
scenes.text: Stop the clutter coming back. Find mailing lists, read their emails, and review supported unsubscribe requests before sending.

scenes.title: Classes and automation
scenes.text: Create your own classes. Choose cleanup rules and confidence thresholds. Turn on automation for selected classes.

scenes.title: Command line
scenes.text: Prefer the command line? Scan, preview changes with a dry run, and inspect your settings, right from the terminal.

scenes.title: Local history and privacy
scenes.text: Your run history stays on your computer. Revisit past activity, protect saved runs with a password, and choose a compatible local model.

scenes.title: End card
scenes.text: Make room for what matters. Find Inboxed at inboxed dot F Y I.
